observations.observation: The NBA and NBPA's end-of-season lists put the Knicks at No. 1 in team merchandise sales for the 2025-26 regular season. Jalen Brunson's jersey ranked No. 3, behind Stephen Curry and Luka Dončić.
observations.audience: Online buyers of NBA jerseys and team gear, nationwide and abroad
observations.limitations: Counts only NBAStore.com, Fanatics.com and Fanatics partner sites. It has no regional split, misses the MSG store and independent shops, and predates the title.

observations.observation: Peter Lanza, owner of Legend's Sporting Goods in Bay Ridge, told News 12 that Knicks championship gear brought a sales boom he had not seen since 2000. The family store has run for 40 years.
observations.audience: Brooklyn shoppers at a neighborhood sporting goods store
observations.timeframe: June 2026, the week of the title and parade
observations.limitations: One store owner in one Brooklyn neighborhood, right after the title. Anecdote, no sales figures. The page URL and the date reported for it differ by a day, so only the month is recorded.

observations.observation: The brief says Brooklyn reads as Nets and keeps 'BK' for the Nets. News 12 reports Knicks championship gear flying off the shelves at Brooklyn small businesses after the title.
observations.audience: Brooklyn Knicks fans and the small shops that serve them
observations.limitations: One local news story from the peak of title euphoria. It shows Knicks demand exists in Brooklyn, not how large it is next to Nets demand.

observations.observation: Newsweek, citing a Dick's Sporting Goods employee quoted by the New York Post, reports a store sold out its 300 NBA Finals hats at once. It also reports fans upset that online orders through Fanatics had long delivery dates.
observations.audience: Fans buying Finals and title gear in stores and online
observations.limitations: Secondhand: Newsweek repeating a Post quote from one employee at one store. No publication date was shown. Fan complaints come from social media and are directional only.

observations.observation: Rolling Stone reports Knicks championship merchandise selling out online right after the Finals win, with Fanatics and Nike among the sellers.

observations.observation: Paper reports courtside and party looks built on puns and color, not jerseys. Taylor Swift wore a 'Steve Knicks' tee and the Haim sisters wore Knicks-pun shirts. A stylist's client wore a blue Staud dress with orange stripes as her game-day 'Knicks Dress'.
observations.audience: Celebrities and style-led women fans at Finals games and watch parties
observations.limitations: Celebrity and stylist-led looks picked by a fashion magazine. Not typical of the Garden crowd or borough fans.

observations.observation: Paper shows women dressing for Knicks games in team colors with few or no official pieces. Stylist Tania Ali wore wide-leg jeans, an official Knicks hat and an orange hoodie tied over her shoulders for Game 3. The fanbase segments name no women's segment.
observations.audience: Women fans who dress in orange and blue as fashion
observations.limitations: A handful of looks from one stylist's circle in one fashion story. Shows the segment exists, not its size.

observations.timeframe: 2026 playoffs (Eastern Conference Finals); no date shown
